limitations: Evidence pipeline in this run used hard-coded object-ID-based displacement and motion fallbacks.
Downstream lifecycle results describe a synthetic single-observation simulation rather than empirical multi-session SLAM tracking.
Statistical claim matrix in paper_benchmark_report.md was a static Markdown template that contradicted the non-significant accuracy difference (p=0.2292) stored in statistical_metrics_summary.json.
B7 Oracle policy was included in the policy summary without an explicit non-deployable diagnostic designation.
